confidence_notes: Overall medium. Restaurant meal and beer anchors are best supported by Numbeo's La Spezia page (Oct 2026, user-submitted), which travel-guide ranges broadly match. Coffee blends Numbeo, Italy-wide and travel-guide figures. Cocktail and wine lack La Spezia per-drink data (only single aperitivo reviews, about EUR 7 and EUR 10), so they follow the local beer relationship: cocktail about 1.7x draught beer and wine glass about 1x, checked against Italy-wide ranges. Beer uses a 0.5 L draught benchmark, so a smaller pour would cost less. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season; no accommodation search was run and no booking pages or listings were inspected. FX is the latest RBA observation found in search results (2026-11-18), not verified on the live RBA table; search results carried conflicting dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No accommodation comparables were searched. Food and drink are anchored to La Spezia's own Numbeo figures, cross-checked against Numbeo comparison pages for Genoa (about 5% higher on eating out) and Pisa (about 9% higher) and against Italy-wide restaurant and aperitivo ranges. Hostel and hotel values are set against Italian coastal mid-sized cities in peak July demand, with Cinque Terre spillover. Euro prices were converted to USD using a EUR/USD cross-rate derived from the same RBA observation.
